title: Online Yoga Platform
short_desc: A home yoga platform I built for my girlfriend. It has a video library with routines and a log to track progress over time.
problem: My girlfriend wanted one place for her yoga routines and her training notes.
built: A web app with a video library of routines and a log of every session. Videos load quickly and play smoothly.
result: One place for both practice and training notes.
tech_notes: A web app with a video library and a database that stores each logged session, so progress can be followed over time. The video pages are set up to load quickly.
